articles.title: Binance says hackers who stole billions in crypto spent months planning heist
articles.summary: The hackers who stole billions of dollars in cryptocurrency from the Binance exchange spent months working on the theft and used both social engineering and novel malware in the process, the company said Tuesday. articles.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
articles.summary: Unknown hackers hijacked more than 300 Tor exit nodes and reconfigured them to favor unencrypted email traffic and redirect SSH connections through servers they controlled, a researcher reported Tuesday. articles.summary: The M-Vave FM-1 is exactly the kind of device I have a weakness for.
